_ADVTECH-ADD. yes = stateless ephemeral OS disk (required for the ephemeral-FSLogix lab). no = stock CloudLabs managed OS disk (default, unchanged behaviour).
_ADVTECH-ADD. Where the ephemeral OS disk lives. D-series v5 = ResourceDisk, D-series v6 = NvmeDisk. MUST match the chosen SKU. Ignored when ephemeralOSDisk='no'.
_ADVTECH-ADD. VM disk controller. Empty = Azure default for the SKU (matches stock CL). v5 = SCSI, v6 = NVMe. The gallery image MUST declare the controller in its features.
_ADVTECH-ADD. yes = run the CloudLabs CustomScriptExtension (user provisioning + trainer shadow), default/unchanged. no = skip it for raw image-boot validation.

_ADVTECH-ADD. OPTIONAL OVERRIDE. Base64-encoded JSON read at boot by cl-bootstrap-portable.ps1 (keys: shareUnc, profilesAcctId). Leave EMPTY: when keystoneStorageAccountName is set, the template DERIVES this automatically from the keystone params. Non-empty = used verbatim (override). Empty + no keystone = stock CL (no userData).

_ADVTECH-ADD. yes = ensure a DID-anchored managed data disk 'DataDisk-<DeploymentID>' exists and attach it (deleteOption=Detach, so it survives VM delete). First deploy creates it BLANK (dataDiskSizeGB) and cl-bootstrap-portable.ps1 initializes + formats + mounts it as E: at first boot. Every delete+recreate of the same DeploymentID re-attaches the SAME disk with data preserved (idempotent PUT: identical creationData = no-op). no = no data disk (stock CL).

_ADVTECH-ADD. Size (GiB) of the BLANK data disk attached when dataDiskFromImage=yes. The virgin disk is initialized/formatted/mounted as E: by the image bootstrap at first boot. 32 keeps managed-disk cost minimal (the OS is ephemeral/free); set 64/128 for more nested-guest capacity.

_ADVTECH-ADD. Name of the Keystone (Part 1) Premium FileStorage account that holds the FSLogix profiles share. Non-empty = this is an ephemeral-FSLogix lab: the template creates a DID-anchored UAMI 'id-<DeploymentID>', grants it Key Operator on THIS account, and wires a per-lab Private Endpoint + private DNS to it (unless keystonePrivateEndpointMode='preProvisioned'). Empty = stock CL (no identity, no PE).
_ADVTECH-ADD. Resource group of the Keystone storage account (may differ from the lab RG). Used to scope the cross-RG role assignment and to build the storage resource ID for the Private Endpoint.
_ADVTECH-ADD. Subscription of the Keystone storage account. Defaults to the lab subscription; set explicitly for cross-subscription Keystone storage.

_ADVTECH-ADD. GUID of the built-in 'Storage Account Key Operator Service Role'. The DID-anchored UAMI needs this on the Keystone Files account so the in-guest bootstrap can listKeys for the cmdkey SMB mount.
_ADVTECH-ADD. Name of the FSLogix profiles SMB share on the Keystone Files account. Used to derive the userData shareUnc.

_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). perLab = current behaviour: every lab deploys its own Private Endpoint + private DNS zone/link (correct when each lab has its OWN VNet). preProvisioned = skip the per-lab 'wire-storage' deployment because the shared VNet already has ONE Keystone PE + DNS (created by shared-ingress.json). Use preProvisioned with publicIpMode='shared': otherwise every launch re-PUTs the same PE/zone in the shared VNet and concurrent launches conflict.

_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). dedicated = stock CL: one Standard public IP per lab VM (default, unchanged behaviour). shared = NO per-lab public IP. The lab NIC claims one free RDP NAT slot on the shared ingress load balancer (shared-ingress.json), so the VM is reached at <shared FQDN>:<slot port>; outbound goes through the shared subnet's NAT Gateway. Requires virtualNetworkNewOrExisting='existing' pointing at the shared ingress VNet/subnet.

_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). Resource group holding the shared load balancer + shared RDP public IP. EMPTY (default) = the existing VNet's resource group (existingVnetResourceGroupName), i.e. shared-ingress.json was deployed into the VNet RG. Must be in the SAME subscription and region as the per-lab resource groups.
_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). Name of the shared Standard load balancer that holds the RDP NAT slot pool.
_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). Name of the shared RDP public IP (its FQDN is returned as the 'DNS Name' host).
_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). Name prefix of the slot NAT rules on the shared LB. Must match rdpRulePrefix in shared-ingress.json.

_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). auto = read the LB at deploy time; if this lab's NIC already owns a slot (delete+recreate of the same DeploymentID) reuse it, otherwise take a FREE slot (offset by DeploymentID so simultaneous launches spread out). deterministic = slot = DeploymentID mod poolSize (no LB read; only safe if live DeploymentIDs are close together, otherwise two labs can land on the same slot and the second launch fails).
_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). Ops/testing only. >= 0 forces this slot index (0-based, sorted by port). -1 = use sharedPortAllocation.

_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). How the 'DNS Name' output is returned in shared mode. hostAndPort = 'labrdp-xxxx.<region>.cloudapp.azure.com:50123' (works when the portal builds an RDP file / mstsc full address from it). hostOnly = FQDN only; the port is then only in the 'RDP Port' output. Ignored in dedicated mode.

_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP). auto (recommended, set once and leave) = every launch checks the VNet resource group for the tag 'shared-ingress-<sharedLoadBalancerName>'. If it is missing (very first launch), this launch creates the shared ingress there: shared RDP public IP, load balancer with the RDP port-slot pool, NAT Gateway attached to the lab subnet (existing subnet settings kept), the Keystone private endpoint/DNS (when keystonePrivateEndpointMode='preProvisioned'), and then writes the tag. Every later launch sees the tag and creates nothing shared. always = rebuild every launch (testing only; simultaneous launches would conflict). never = shared ingress was created some other way. Make the very first launch a single test launch, not a whole class at once.

_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP, used only when the shared ingress is created). Number of RDP port slots = max lab VMs that can exist at once (running or stopped). 800 is the maximum and costs nothing extra (inbound NAT rules are free); the subnet's free IPs are the real limit.
_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP, bootstrap only). Public port of slot 0; slot n = start + n.
_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP, bootstrap only). DNS label of the shared RDP public IP. Empty = 'labrdp-<unique>' derived from the VNet resource group.
_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP, bootstrap only). NAT Gateway giving the lab subnet outbound internet now that VMs have no public IP.

_ADVTECH-ADD (shared IP, used only when the shared ingress is created). yes = create the NAT Gateway and attach it to the lab subnet (the subnet's current settings such as NSG, route table, service endpoints and delegations are read and kept). no = the subnet already has outbound internet (existing NAT Gateway or firewall route); the subnet is left untouched.

variables.keptSubnetProperties: [toObject(filter(items(parameters('currentSubnetProperties')), lambda('p', contains(variables('writableSubnetKeys'), lambdaVariables('p').key))), lambda('p', lambdaVariables('p').key), lambda('p', lambdaVariables('p').value))]

rules.value: [if(variables('isSharedIp'), map(reference(variables('sharedLbId'), '2024-05-01').inboundNatRules, lambda('r', createObject('id', lambdaVariables('r').id, 'name', lambdaVariables('r').name, 'port', lambdaVariables('r').properties.frontendPort, 'owner', if(contains(lambdaVariables('r').properties, 'backendIPConfiguration'), lambdaVariables('r').properties.backendIPConfiguration.id, '')))), createArray())]

metadata.description: _ADVTECH-ADD. Picks the RDP NAT slot for this lab. No resources: it only reads the LB rule list passed in and returns the chosen rule id + port.

variables.pool: [sort(filter(parameters('rules'), lambda('r', startsWith(lambdaVariables('r').name, parameters('rulePrefix')))), lambda('a', 'b', less(lambdaVariables('a').port, lambdaVariables('b').port)))]
variables.pick: [if(variables('useFixedSlot'), if(less(variables('fixedIndex'), length(variables('pool'))), variables('pool')[variables('fixedIndex')], variables('noSlot')), if(greater(length(variables('mine')), 0), first(variables('mine')), if(greater(length(variables('free')), 0), variables('free')[mod(int(parameters('deploymentId')), length(variables('free')))], variables('noSlot'))))]

properties.securityProfile: [if(and(equals(parameters('vmImageType'), 'custom'), not(equals(parameters('vmSecurityType'), 'GET-VM-CUSTOM-IMAGE-SECURITY-TYPE'))), if(or(equals(parameters('vmSecurityType'), 'ConfidentialVM'), equals(parameters('vmSecurityType'), 'TrustedLaunch')), json(concat('{"uefiSettings": {"secureBootEnabled": true, "vTpmEnabled": true}, "securityType": "', parameters('vmSecurityType'), '"}')), variables('SetVmSecurityType')), json('null'))]

protectedSettings.commandToExecute: [concat('powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -File s/arm-templates/scripts/psscript.ps1 ', variables('Enable-CloudLabsEmbeddedShadow'), ' ', parameters('vmCustomImageOsState'), ' ', parameters('vmAdminUserName'), ' ', variables('vmPasswordAdmin'), ' ', parameters('provisionNonAdminUser'), ' ', parameters('vmNonAdminUserName'), ' ', variables('vmPasswordNonAdmin'), ' ', parameters('vmImageType'))]
